verdict.rationale: First-party README states the agent branches, commits, pushes, and opens pull requests via `gh`, which covers the core of the story. Permission prompts for write and destructive commands add review safety. Staging and commit-message authoring are only implied by "commits" and are not documented explicitly, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of staging changes, explicit documentation of agent-written commit messages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests

citations.quote: The agent clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews pull requests with `gh`.
Write commands ask once per session; destructive ones always ask.
